summary.text: Brandy L. Pyle is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 22 (Casselton) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Brandy L. Pyle's service as "House since 2017". The member page lists Brandy L. Pyle's committee assignments as including the Appropriations standing committee and, as Vice Chair, the Administrative Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Brandy L. Pyle's occupation as Self Employed.
It lists education as BS, Finance, University of Minnesota Carlson School of Mangement.
It lists military service as MN National Guard (6 years).

It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Cass County Park Board; RLND Class VII; Global Bridges Fellow; CSG BILLD Fellow; Henry Toll Fellow; Haley’s Hope; The Village; Fargo National Cemetery Volunteer Committee; Westminster Presbyterian Church.
Brandy L. Pyle is listed as married to Nicholas with 4 children.
